bio.introText: Hi, I’m Tayfun. I’m a junior full-stack developer passionate about building scalable and user-focused web applications using React, JavaScript, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

skillsList.skillDetails: Strong understanding of ES6+ features, event handling, DOM manipulation, and API integration.
Experience with component-based architecture, hooks, state management, and Tailwind CSS.
Built secure REST APIs with Spring Boot, Spring Security, JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL integration.

content: I'm a Junior Full Stack Developer with a strong interest in building scalable and modern web applications. I’ve completed an intensive 960-hour full-time training where I developed real-world projects using React, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

Coming from a Biomedical Engineering background, I combine analytical thinking with a passion for clean code and user-focused design. I’m constantly learning and enjoy working in collaborative, agile environments where I can contribute and grow as a developer.

projectList.projectDesc: A secure RESTful API developed with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL. Includes role-based JWT authentication, product/order/review management and modular architecture.
A Java console app for managing books and members. Includes CRUD operations, fee calculation, and role-based logic for librarians and readers.
A personal portfolio built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Supports dark mode and bilingual content (English/Turkish).
Bluetooth-controlled LED matrix animations with ESP32 and Unity mobile app. Real-time scrolling text and over 15 custom animations.

footer.collabHeader: Let’s work together on your next product.
